_methodology_note: Each macro_category has a persona_eligible flag. true = relationally-mediated harm (requester identity shapes framing/severity, route through both persona-conditioned and taxonomy-driven generation passes). false = environmentally-mediated harm (harm mechanism invariant to requester, route through taxonomy-driven generation only). See memory note for citation precedent (HarmBench standard/contextual split, WebSearch-Harm strategy allocation, AART parametrized recipes, socio-technical red-teaming context-dependence). | Seed expansion: identity-shifted cross-framings retained per Contextual Integrity (Nissenbaum 2004; sender/receiver as flow parameters) for information/surveillance harms, and relational-vulnerability framing for physical harms; factorial relational variation follows ConfAIde (Mireshghallah et al. 2024). Verbatim non-shifted duplicates (former PHISH-3/4/6) dropped. 'derived_from' tags the source seed for per-mechanism dedup capping.
